meta.source: https://www.atomteam.pl/ (Wix theme palette and computed styles, read 2026-09-29)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark theme = the site's deep plum sections (theme color_30).

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section band and header bar fill. Light value is the site's lilac mist; dark is color_20.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: inputs, placeholders behind images (color_12 / color_35).

tokens.name: header-glass
tokens.usage: Floating pill header over hero imagery (73% lilac mist, exact from site).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on `surface` and `surface-alt`. 21:1 light; 16:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and subtitles on `surface` (8.5:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text and borders only. 3:1 on white: never for body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand pink (theme action color_18): primary buttons, links, highlights, 42px accent headlines. On white only 2.5:1: FAILS for text — use it as text only on `surface` in the dark theme (7.5:1) or at display size as decoration; on light grounds prefer `accent-strong` for text.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Violet emphasis text (bold 22px pull-quotes) and feature-card shadow. 5.9:1 on white; dark theme lifts to #c580ff (7:1 on plum).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on `accent` fills, exact from the site's primary button. 2.5:1 — FAILS AA; keep labels 14px+ bold or switch to `ink-on-accent`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring; 3:1+ on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: shadow-pink
tokens.usage: Colour of the offset shadow under rider cards.

tokens.name: shadow-violet
tokens.usage: Colour of the offset shadow under feature media blocks.

tokens.name: pink-100
tokens.usage: Pink scale, lightest (color_16). Tints behind pink content.

tokens.name: pink-500
tokens.usage: Pink scale darkest (color_20); link text on staff/rider names.

tokens.name: plum-500
tokens.usage: Plum scale darkest (color_30): dark section and footer ground.

tokens.name: lilac-mist
tokens.usage: Signature pale lilac: light bands and large type on plum.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, often in `accent` or `lilac-mist` on plum.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Most running copy on the site, rider captions, buttons (font_9).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gallery item margin, gap between rider cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Hard offset pink shadow under rider cards; no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-feature
tokens.usage: Hard offset violet shadow under feature media.
